status: schema active; preseason external diagnostic ranks will be supplemented by live nflverse/NGS-derived unit metrics once regular season begins
principles: Unit ratings are opponent-adjusted where data permits.
External rankings are diagnostic anchors only and never converted directly into betting points.
OL is treated as a continuity/weakest-link unit rather than the sum of five player grades.
Injuries update currentPersonnelState separately from season-long unit quality.
Matchup effects are incremental to the base team rating and must avoid double counting.
Every matchup adjustment is capped and logged with drivers.
